description: Expansion of rag_eval_tr_en.json: every category in English and Turkish. Expected sets are produced by the recorded rule over the catalog snapshot.

label_tiers.automatic_candidate: Relevant set computed by a simple catalog rule (title, author, category, description, length, year). Real ISBNs, but over- and under-inclusive and NOT reviewed by a person. Not ground truth.

categories.exact_title: The user names the book (known item); any edition is a hit.
categories.author: Books by a named author.
categories.semantic_description: The plot or idea is described without the title (known item).
categories.multi_constraint: Two or more constraints at once (author/genre plus length or period).
categories.mood: A mood or reading preference instead of a subject.
categories.ambiguous: Under-specified taste request; no fixed relevant set.
categories.insufficient_info: Not enough information to identify any book; the system should not invent one.
categories.no_relevant: A real book/author/subject the catalog does not hold; the system must say so, not substitute.

expected_behaviors.retrieve_relevant: Return catalog books from the expected set.
expected_behaviors.open_judgment: Return plausible catalog books; judged by hand, not scored.
expected_behaviors.no_fabrication: Do not invent a specific book; ask for detail or offer a broad, honest suggestion.
expected_behaviors.abstain_not_in_catalog: State that the requested work/author is not in the catalog; do not present another book as it.
